key_insight: Faynt shows that a single Transformer policy can be scaled and post-trained to play all 26 Super Smash Bros. Melee characters competitively, with strong win rates against specialist baselines.
engineering_relevance: The paper demonstrates a practical pipeline for large-scale policy pretraining, distillation, and low-latency inference in a complex real-time game environment.
method: Pretrain 10M and 75M Transformer policies on about 840,000 human replays.
Use post-training with rank- and outcome-based curricula, 75M-to-10M distillation, and Fox-mirror RL.
Optimize inference on recorded game states for fast decision-making on GPU.
evidence_signal: On the 152-game benchmark, the supervised 10M model won 69.7% of games, and after RL it won 240 of 244 same-character games (98.4%) against fourteen baseline releases.
watch_item: The reported gains are confounded by different action delays between Faynt and several baselines, so the effect of latency is not isolated.
paper_title: Faynt: Scaling and Optimizing Policies for Competitive Melee
